security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: The SQL container's environment declares a literal SA_PASSWORD value in the deployment manifest (value omitted). This supplies a fixed password for SQL Server rather than a runtime secret reference.

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
security.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

evidence.explanation: The SQL container's environment declares a literal SA_PASSWORD value in the deployment manifest (value omitted), constituting a hard-coded authentication credential.
